title: lint.yml: the step whose ledgered-closure premise named knowledge-ragflow now guards an empty ledger (DEBT and TEST_DEBT are both {})
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZmwqAVSYHM1nQUDTq

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · from PR #37477 (#37004) Acceptance notes · Area: o5-A

## What happens
A `.github/workflows/lint.yml` comment said `@objectstack/knowledge-ragflow` pulls `service-knowledge` into a ledger closure. PR #37477 rewrites the comment only. The card thread measured that `DEBT` and `TEST_DEBT` were already `{}` on `main`, so the premise was stale before the retirement and the step's ledger reason is empty.

## Done when
Whoever owns that step decides whether it still earns its place (gate inventory only shrinks without a named reason); either remove it or write the premise it now serves.

reach: CI time on every PR; read from lint.yml and the ledgers.
Business reason: a gate whose reason is gone costs every PR.
Reader: triage → tooling (`.github/workflows/**`, governed).
Dedupe: `lint.yml ledger closure DEBT TEST_DEBT` → none.
